lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating fixed anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance spots are visible and distributed across the surface of the dorsal fin silhouette protruding from the upper midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, irregular high-luminance white patch is visible on the posterior-lateral flank, distinct in size and intensity from the standard patterning.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed, small-diameter high-luminance spots on the cephalic region and the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
